item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=Experimental+distinction+between+chemical+hysteresis+and+true+history-dependent+memory+in+autocatalytic+networks&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1037/0278-7393.12.2.307\", \"title\": [\"What kind of a hypothesis is the distinction between episodic and semantic memory?\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1037/0278-7393.12.2.307\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1986, 4]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1021/acs.jctc.5c01979.s001\", \"title\": [\"Enumeration of Autocatalytic Subsystems in Large Chemical Reaction Networks\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.5c01979.s001\"}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1037/0278-7393.12.2.312\", \"title\": [\"More on the distinction between episodic and semantic memories.\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1037/0278-7393.12.2.312\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1986]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1080/00335557843000061\", \"title\": [\"Mental Imagery and the Distinction between Primary and Secondary Memory\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Previous research has shown that the imageability of stimulus material affects the secondary memory (SM) component of free recall, but not the primary memory (PM) component, and that a negative recency effect is only observed for material of high imageability. It was found that interactive imagery instructions affected the SM component, but not the PM component; separative imagery instructions led to an increased PM component and a reduced SM component. A negative recency effect can be observed in an initial, delayed recall test. However, it is removed by imagery mnemonic instructions. This supports the idea that the negative recency effect is caused by the fact that subjects do not normally image the last few words presented in a free-recall task.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1080/00335557843000061\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1978, 8]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "33169f906c0b61b32f57613f52a4c7f178e037d29f34b0f073f9814ea0670098", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "autocatalytic_memory", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1037/0278-7393.12.2.307", "doi:10.1021/acs.jctc.5c01979.s001", "doi:10.1037/02…
